mapper.select: select T.ACT_ID_ as KEY_, T.BUCKET_, count(*) as COUNT_, sum(T.DURATION_) as TOTAL_, min(T.DURATION_) as MIN_, max(T.DURATION_) as MAX_ , sum(case when T.DURATION_ <= #{target} then 1 else 0 end) as WITHIN_ from ( select A.ACT_ID_, A.DURATION_, ${activityBucketSql} as BUCKET_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A where and A.END_TIME_ >= #{after} and A.END_TIME_ < #{before} and A.DURATION_ is not null and (A.ACT_INST_STATE_ is null or A.ACT_INST_STATE_ <> 2) ) T group by T.ACT_ID_, T.BUCKET_

select A.ACT_ID_, A.ACT_TYPE_, max(A.ACT_NAME_) as ACT_NAME_, sum(case when A.ACT_INST_STATE_ is null or A.ACT_INST_STATE_ <> 2 then 1 else 0 end) as FINISHED_, sum(case when A.ACT_INST_STATE_ = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as CANCELED_, 0 as RUNNING_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A where and A.END_TIME_ >= #{after} and A.END_TIME_ < #{before} group by A.ACT_ID_, A.ACT_TYPE_

select A.ACT_ID_, A.ACT_TYPE_, max(A.ACT_NAME_) as ACT_NAME_, 0 as FINISHED_, 0 as CANCELED_, count(*) as RUNNING_, min(A.START_TIME_) as OLDEST_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A where and A.END_TIME_ is null group by A.ACT_ID_, A.ACT_TYPE_

select A.ACT_ID_ as KEY_, count(*) as COUNT_, 0 as EXTRA_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A where and A.END_TIME_ is null and ((A.ACT_ID_ = #{entry.activityId} and A.START_TIME_ < #{entry.since})) group by A.ACT_ID_

select R.ACT_ID_ as KEY_, count(*) as COUNT_, sum(R.RUNS_ - 1) as EXTRA_ from ( select A.ACT_ID_, A.PARENT_ACT_INST_ID_, count(*) as RUNS_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A where and A.END_TIME_ >= #{after} and A.END_TIME_ < #{before} and A.ACT_TYPE_ not in ('exclusiveGateway', 'parallelGateway', 'inclusiveGateway', 'eventBasedGateway', 'complexGateway', 'multiInstanceBody') group by A.ACT_ID_, A.PARENT_ACT_INST_ID_ having count(*) > 1 ) R group by R.ACT_ID_

select I.ACTIVITY_ID_ as KEY_, sum(case when I.INCIDENT_STATE_ = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as COUNT_, sum(case when I.CREATE_TIME_ >= #{after} and I.CREATE_TIME_ < #{before} then 1 else 0 end) as EXTRA_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_INCIDENT I where and (I.INCIDENT_STATE_ = 0 or (I.CREATE_TIME_ >= #{after} and I.CREATE_TIME_ < #{before})) group by I.ACTIVITY_ID_

select '' as KEY_, T.BUCKET_, count(*) as COUNT_, sum(T.DURATION_) as TOTAL_, min(T.DURATION_) as MIN_, max(T.DURATION_) as MAX_ , sum(case when T.DURATION_ <= #{target} then 1 else 0 end) as WITHIN_ from ( select P.DURATION_, ${instanceBucketSql} as BUCKET_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P where and P.END_TIME_ >= #{after} and P.END_TIME_ < #{before} and P.DURATION_ is not null and (P.STATE_ is null or P.STATE_ = 'COMPLETED') ) T group by T.BUCKET_

select sum(case when P.STATE_ is null or P.STATE_ = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end) as COMPLETED_, sum(case when P.STATE_ in ('INTERNALLY_TERMINATED', 'EXTERNALLY_TERMINATED') then 1 else 0 end) as TERMINATED_, 0 as RUNNING_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P where and P.END_TIME_ >= #{after} and P.END_TIME_ < #{before}
select 0 as COMPLETED_, 0 as TERMINATED_, count(*) as RUNNING_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P where and P.END_TIME_ is null
select P.ID_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P where P.PROC_DEF_KEY_ = #{processDefinitionKey} order by P.ID_

select T.PERIOD_ as KEY_, T.BUCKET_, count(*) as COUNT_, sum(T.DURATION_) as TOTAL_, min(T.DURATION_) as MIN_, max(T.DURATION_) as MAX_ , sum(case when T.DURATION_ <= #{target} then 1 else 0 end) as WITHIN_ from ( select P.DURATION_, ${instanceBucketSql} as BUCKET_, ${periodOfEndSql} as PERIOD_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P where and P.END_TIME_ >= #{periodStart} and P.END_TIME_ < #{periodEnd} and P.DURATION_ is not null and (P.STATE_ is null or P.STATE_ = 'COMPLETED') ) T group by T.PERIOD_, T.BUCKET_

select A.ID_ as ACT_INST_ID_, A.PROC_INST_ID_, A.PROC_DEF_ID_, P.BUSINESS_KEY_, A.START_TIME_, A.END_TIME_, A.DURATION_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A left join ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P on P.ID_ = A.PROC_INST_ID_ where and A.ACT_ID_ = #{activityId} and A.END_TIME_ >= #{after} and A.END_TIME_ < #{before} and A.DURATION_ is not null and (A.ACT_INST_STATE_ is null or A.ACT_INST_STATE_ <> 2) order by A.DURATION_ desc, A.ID_

select A.ID_ as ACT_INST_ID_, A.PROC_INST_ID_, A.PROC_DEF_ID_, P.BUSINESS_KEY_, A.START_TIME_, A.END_TIME_, A.DURATION_ from ${prefix}ACT_HI_ACTINST A left join ${prefix}ACT_HI_PROCINST P on P.ID_ = A.PROC_INST_ID_ where and A.ACT_ID_ = #{activityId} and A.END_TIME_ is null order by A.START_TIME_ asc, A.ID_
